book.name: Apanll Ashtachu Anu
book.title: Apanll ashtachu anu Yuwaa Apanll tputsee wanichu anoo kamankiya Wangarini

content: Na minootssha kamanchintspa yuwaa Apanll nuwaam yámandarangu anootsi

Nllitaritsha miranishpaz ashiru parangina mangeetsich kizpur p'tsimaama. Kanindap naparanguri, kiz tamapari ashiru parangina. Wamarsha zar tamapari ashiru 'sineerangiya. Watssha tsupimun katirangiya. Tsangachee k'tsas tsimbun matayaru tutayarangiya.
Itaru, mireerangiya. Wipaa ksutku, chik ksurangu, yay, tárangiya.
Kanindap minootstam parangina; yasariya tamapari ashiru itaru kizpur kapungcha nuw parangi. Kizpur chumbeepcha. Muchsha tsimbun matayaru taarangiya. Witssha kayungshisheem kuwiz iptaru taarangiya.
Muchumun tsimbunutam matayaru tutayarangiya.
Wanishpatsha tsangachee chawap kurixeeru, pshiyreeru, tsapupsha kapeeta ashirangiya. Yasariysha kizaa tasasarangiya. Wipaa tatsipkachu, nuwsha zapi átu nlluraa kutarangiya.
Kutayaru, kizsha wipaa tatsipurangiya. Wip watacha tsapurunasshuchee wamari kasimaam waritarangiya; wizpurpat izuuru tpachingachu anu.

Ashirucha, tatsipeeru, yasariysha katungeeya atitaa, itaru Apanll waana tatutsirangiya. Tatutseeru, waanpeet tunaringarangiya; kizpur kurakaam ínarangiya; washunand Apanllpatatam wamari kasiru taariya.
Itaru, kizsha upusap suwarangiya. Apanll anush kamungshisheem wayarangiya. Amb suwayaru, anush 1260 zari taachiya. Apanll waana napchiya kizaatsi.

Yuwamand kiz upusap kamungarangu anumandsha yasariy tsiyantarangu, kanindush waratarangiya. Apanll wasundurur urkari, Migueli sura wasundururpata xiyarsin, yasariyaa tasasartayarusin, warataranganaya waanpata wasundururpata. Kizpur waratatangat ashiranganaya.
Itaru, Apanll wasundurur yasariyaa kasiranganaya. Kasiyarusin, yasariysha kanindap naamaam pinasarangiya.
Yasariyaa

kasiyarusin, izuuru kapeetambaranganaya wasundururpatatam washunanda. Yasariya watacha Yashinguya; yuwatam sirútamasa mkaam kinayaru, tputsee tamapingarangu anu. Apanllcha undarari. Uru Apanllchichee yutarit tsiyatarangiya. Parangi anoo arangeem kamanchintspa. Ashiri mazinangtsa.

Ashirucha, Yashingoo tsapush kapeeteeru, Apanllchich tputs shambatkusin, kanindap kizpur tsiyatsis kimarangiya. Apanll kizpurcha. Natsha iyaa izuuru tapachindayanlliya. Na izuuru kasiyanlliya, táranganaya. Apanll Ipusamarini kizpurcha; na wamari kasiriya. Watam Yashingoo kapeetaranguwa. Yashing uru Apanllee tasaseeru, iyaa zuwanlleetsini yutarit tsiyatarangiya; tputsirish yutaritssincha, tárangiya Apanlleetsi. Nda kasamaam zandarangiya. Kaschiritam, psaantam tamundarangiya.

Itaru, iy zuwanllini Isusumun ursir Yashingoo kasiranganaya. Isus yutaritshishirinimand opeeja tamapari ashiru tsiparangiya. Ashirucha, anumun kasiranganaya; Isusoo kuk kapung kamanirangsin, kasamaam nda zandaranganaya. Waanaatstaa watsipun nda pachindarangsin, ashiritaa Isusoo kuk kasamaam nda zandaranganaya. Anumand Yashingoo kasiranganaya.

Ashiriya, Apanll tiptsir ichingurusin shambatchinllinaya. Apanllchich tputs kapung shambatchinllinpa, yuwamand Yashingoo izuuru tsapush kapeetarangu anumanda. Itaru, tsapurunasshuch tputs paptsa, misha kungootstam maachi ichinguru paptsa. Kizpur kiyung kachiyachpasa. Yashing tsapush pantsarangu, kizpurinasha tsiyantakiya watam Apanll waneeshi tutundkachu anoo waana yasakuwa; tárangana Apanllchich tputsi, ántarusin mazinarangina.
Ashirucha, yasariyaa tsapush kapeeteersin, yasariysha nlluraa xapooyaru, kizpur tsiyantayaru, kizaatssha kiyung yachachima, tárangu tachitarangiya.

Itaru, Apanllsha kizaam wazitpungach tsimbun kapung yáyarur tamapari ashiru panarangiya. Kizsha anpat upusap suwayaru, mangakatara ashirangiya. Apanll waana taárasheem upusap wayarangiya. Amb suwayaru, Apanll waana kizaa naparangiya. Amb tuchip masach anumun chawap taachiya kamungumaama.
Ashirucha, kiz suwayaru, yasariysha tachitarangiya. Tachiteeru, kukush kungpaz ashiru kapung kawachirangiya. Kizaa pachapi átu ashirangiya; kachingamaam zandarangiya.
Itaru, tsapsha kizaa istarangiya. Kung kizpur zaw ashirangtaa, itaru tsapsha ichinguru waakatara ashirangiya.

Anumand yasariysha aranginasha tsiyantarangiya kizaatsi. Ashiriya, kizaa xapooyaru, kizachchee tputsi kiyung yachapi átu xiyrangiya; kapung waratamaam zandarangiya. Kizachich tputs watacha Apanllee kuk izuuru payukana anu. Watatamcha Isusoo kuk kapung kamankusin, nda paziksin, Isusoo kuk nda kasakana anu.

Ashirucha, yasariysha kapung waratamaam xiyarangu, musamun wing' xiyarangiya. Wipunasheemsha kutarangiya. Apanll nuwaam wasina yámandarangiya yuwaa ashtachu anootsi. Parangi anoo kamanirangtaati, itaru wand pishtakiya ashimaama. Ashiriya, yuwaa Yashing' nimun yusur kiyung yachchu anoo kamaneena.

footnotes.text: Apanll chtarangu 3.1-5 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
